# The Inn

**The Inn** is a WoW addon for a guild: shared achievements, leaderboards and a feed of what guildmates have been up to, synced in game between everyone who runs it. It is made for WoW: Forever (interface 16001).

![The tavern window: the sign, your bar tab, the plaques you're closest to, last night's gossip and the notice board](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bergeet/the-inn/main/docs/screenshot.png)

- **Achievements**: about 130, plus custom ones officers can create and grant.
- **Scoreboard**: leaderboards for points, deaths, PvP, duels and chess.
- **Gossip**: a feed of unlocks, deaths, and duel and chess results.
- **Workshop**: who in the guild has which profession and can craft which recipe.
- **Chess**: play a guildie, or practise against the barkeep.

It only reads game state and never acts for you (see [Staying within Blizzard's rules](#staying-within-blizzards-rules)).

Install, commands and officer tools are in [TheInn/README.md](https://github.com/bergeet/the-inn/blob/main/TheInn/README.md), the user docs that ship with the addon.

## Layout

```
TheInn/              the addon itself (this folder is what goes in Interface/AddOns)
tests/sim.lua        simulated WoW client + guild: timers, roster, addon channel, saved variables
tests/run.lua        test suite, run against the simulated Forever client
scripts/package.sh   runs the tests, then zips the addon into dist/
scripts/make_textures.py  draws the chess pieces (TheInn/Media/*.tga) and docs/icon.png
```

## Develop

Needs LuaJIT (WoW runs Lua 5.1): `brew install luajit`.

```sh
luajit tests/run.lua                 # all tests
luajit tests/run.lua revoke          # tests whose name contains "revoke"
SIM_VERBOSE=1 luajit tests/run.lua   # show every simulated client's chat output
scripts/package.sh                   # -> dist/TheInn-<version>.zip
python3 scripts/make_textures.py preview.png   # redraw the chess pieces (and a PNG preview)
```

Everything else the window shows is the game's own art (dialog backgrounds, quest parchment, the frame header, the achievement alert), so the addon stays small. If a file is missing on some client, a plain color stands in. The chess pieces have no in-game equivalent: they're plain math in Python (no image libraries). Edit a shape in the script and rerun it.

To test in game without copying files, symlink the addon into the client's AddOns folder and `/reload` after each change:

```sh
ln -s "$PWD/TheInn" "/Applications/World of Warcraft/_forever_/Interface/AddOns/TheInn"
```

## Staying within Blizzard's rules

The addon only reads game state, draws its own UI, and talks over the hidden guild addon channel (plus a guild chat line for guild firsts and big unlocks, on by default, `/inn announce off` to stop it). It doesn't count what the game already keeps: deaths, duels, kills and the like are read from WoW: Forever's own statistics. The Workshop only reads the profession window while the player has it open. Never automate input or gameplay, and keep the code readable and free (Blizzard's UI Add-On Development Policy).

The `addon only uses approved game APIs` test enforces this on every file in the TOC. It checks code only: comments and text in strings never count.

- **Globals.** Every game global the code reads is on `ALLOWED_GLOBALS` in `tests/run.lua`. The only globals it writes are its own saved variables and slash commands, so it never replaces a game function.
- **Namespace fields.** Allowing `C_TradeSkillUI` would also allow its crafting calls, so each `C_` namespace has its own list of fields in `NAMESPACE_FIELDS`. Code must write `C_Name.Field` out in full: no local holding a namespace, no `C_Name[computed key]`. The test can then see every field it touches. `HOOKED_FIELDS` lists the few action functions the addon only post-hooks to count (abandoned quests, emotes). Those may be hooked or nil-checked, never called.
- **Denylist.** `FORBIDDEN_NAMES` (crafting, casting, using items, opening, expanding or filtering the profession windows, running code from strings) may not appear anywhere in the code, on any object. This is **The Inn's own rule, not a list of what Blizzard bans**. Some of these functions are protected by the client anyway. Others, like `ExpandTradeSkillSubClass`, are fine for addons in general but have no place in one that only reads and shares. `CraftRecipe` stays on it for good.

A new game API is a review step. Add it to the right list with a comment on why the addon needs it, and check that it only reads state or drives The Inn's own UI. The test `API policy catches what it should, and only that` feeds the checker known-good and known-bad snippets; extend it when changing the checker.

The simulator can't prove the live client agrees. Before a release that touches game APIs, sync or the Workshop, run the checklist in [docs/live-client-testing.md](https://github.com/bergeet/the-inn/blob/main/docs/live-client-testing.md) in game.

## Releasing

Bump `## Version:` in `TheInn/TheInn.toc`, add a `**x.y.z**` entry to the changelog in `TheInn/README.md`, commit, then tag:

```sh
git tag v0.4.3 && git push origin main v0.4.3
```

GitHub Actions runs the tests, builds `TheInn-0.4.3.zip` and publishes it as a Release, using the changelog entry as the notes. Every push to `main` runs the tests too. `.pkgmeta` is ready for the CurseForge and Wago packagers if the addon is listed there.

releases.name: The Inn 0.10.0
releases.notes:
- **A clean slate.** Not compatible with 0.9.x, so everyone in the guild updates together. Saved data from 0.9.x (unlocks, settings, the gossip) is cleared on the first login; what the game's statistics show is credited again right away.
- Counts now come from WoW: Forever's own statistics instead of the addon counting them: deaths (and by falling, drowning or fire), duels, honorable kills, killing blows, Hearthstone, flights, fishing, epic and legendary loot, abandoned quests, /lol and exalted factions. They go back to each character's first day, and the leaderboards show the game's numbers.
- Achievements for things the game doesn't count are gone: jumps, /dance, /chicken, /flex, /cry, AFK, session length, logins, grey, rare and total loot, fleeing, duel streaks, bad days and solo elites. So are the Jumps and Fled boards, `/inn stats` and the tally under the Scoreboard.
- Forever's two-part names ("Lil Hjalm"): you're no longer listed twice, as yourself and as a guildmate. Your own hello now also confirms the name the guild knows you by.
- Deaths by falling, drowning or fire can now be earned (Forever hides the combat log they used to need).
- **Forever only.** Classic Era support is gone: its old profession, recipe and combat log code went with it, so the Workshop no longer needs collapsed categories expanded.
- Achievements Forever already has are gone, so they aren't earned twice: PvP ranks, profession tiers 150/225/300, Onyxia and reaching level 60. The game's own achievement window has them.
- Lighter: the window uses the game's own art (dialog backgrounds, quest parchment, the frame header and the achievement alert); only the chess pieces are the addon's own. The addon went from 6 MB to under 1 MB.
- Guild chat only gets guild firsts and achievements worth 25 points or more.
- A guildie's recipes now reach guildmates who are offline even if they log out right after sharing them.
- A reinstalled character whose old data is being restored by a guildmate no longer shows a fresh 1200 chess or duel rating to the guild in the meantime.

Install: unzip into `Interface/AddOns` (you should get a `TheInn` folder), then restart WoW.

releases.name: The Inn 0.9.4
releases.notes:
- New achievements: kill elites alone, kill one that outlevels you, and take down Hogger, Gath'Ilzogg or Mor'Ladim before you're supposed to.
- Forever: `/inn grant` and `/inn revoke` work with first and last names, the same way as `/w John Doe`.
- `/inn diag` shows what the game tells the addon, to help track down problems.
- Hidden achievements' text is now plain text in the addon's files, so reading `Data.lua` will spoil them.

Install: unzip into `Interface/AddOns` (you should get a `TheInn` folder), then restart WoW.

releases.name: The Inn 0.9.3
releases.notes:
- Forever: PvP rank achievements can be earned. The game now reports PvP stats differently, so your rank was never read, and it was counted as dishonorable kills instead.
- Forever: PvP ranks show their proper titles on the Scoreboard.
- Dishonorable kills are no longer tracked, and "Dishonorable Discharge" is gone on both clients. If you already earned it, its points no longer count.

Install: unzip into `Interface/AddOns` (you should get a `TheInn` folder), then restart WoW.

releases.name: The Inn 0.9.2
releases.notes:
- The minimap button shows up as soon as you log in, instead of a few seconds later.
- Opening the window in the first few seconds after login says it's settling in, instead of claiming you're not in a guild or that nothing has happened.

Install: unzip into `Interface/AddOns` (you should get a `TheInn` folder), then restart WoW.

releases.name: The Inn 0.9.1
releases.notes:
- The X in the corner closes the window again. It used to hide only the header (the sign, your name and bar tab), which then stayed gone.
- The Scoreboard, the notice board heading and the chess window title use the same easy-to-read font as the rest of the window. The sign keeps its old one.

Install: unzip into `Interface/AddOns` (you should get a `TheInn` folder), then restart WoW.
